title: Nvidia live updates: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO; Trump says he 'convinced' board - Yahoo Finance
description: Nvidia's (NVDA) board on Monday announced that it has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and president of the chip giant.

title: NATO calls urgent meeting as string of incidents escalates Russia tensions - The Washington Post
description: “We are not in war, but we are certainly not in peace anymore, either,” Germany’s foreign minister said after Russian missiles crashed onto Polish territory.

title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya - NPR
description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

title: Wall Street Roars Back as Huang’s Shock Return Propels US Stocks - Bloomberg.com
description: US stocks rallied, recovering from last week’s brutal technology-led selloff, as the stunning return of Jensen Huang to lead Nvidia Corp. propelled Wall Street toward its best day since April 2025.
